verdict.rationale: Adyen's reporting docs say it gives a visual representation of balances, sales, and payouts, so it has a first-party reporting surface tied to settlements. Nothing in the pack shows settlement-to-bank-deposit reconciliation or itemized line items for fees, refunds, and chargebacks. missing for 10: settlement-to-bank-deposit reconciliation reports, itemized fee breakdowns, refund and chargeback line items in reports, downloadable or API-accessible settlement detail reports, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can reconcile settlements to bank deposits with itemized reports covering fees, refunds, and chargebacks

citations.quote: Get a visual representation of your balances, sales, and payouts.
Manage your account and transactions from our Customer Area, which shows an overview of all your payment channels.
